episodes.synopsis: Ichika had a prophetic dream involving all of the girls once again fighting an unstoppable foe. Later, Laura and Charlotte go clothes shopping in preparation for their date with Ichika…in which everyone is invited!
episodes.title: The Memory of a Summer

episodes.synopsis: Ichika may be good at fighting, but the new student council president sees a flaw in him, and she intends to fix it.
episodes.title: Heart Pain Killer

episodes.synopsis: A twisted game of Cinderfella gets deadly serious, and Ichika finds himself once again at the whim of 5 beautiful women.
episodes.title: Translucent Chord of Cinderella's Heel

episodes.synopsis: The mysterious woman is revealed to be Arachne, and she's after Ichika's IS. A new enemy reveals itself, and it may be too powerful for the girls to handle.
episodes.title: The Mysterious Lady

episodes.synopsis: Ichika is forced to be the sole judge of a Maiden Battle, where the girls take turns trying to give him the best "service" possible.
episodes.title: Lovely Style

episodes.synopsis: Ichika's IS is malfunctioning, so while it's away for repairs Charlotte has agreed to protect him.
episodes.title: The Secret Base

episodes.synopsis: Ichika has to choose a partner for the next tournament. Naturally, all the girls think she'll be the one to get picked.
episodes.title: Sisters

episodes.synopsis: The girls find out who Ichika has picked for the tag tournament, and are not too happy, leaving them to train like they've never trained before.
episodes.title: Open Your Heart

episodes.synopsis: A sudden raid by 5 anti IS units sends Ichika and the girls into a tailspin. During the fight, Tatenashi falls unconscious.
episodes.title: What It Takes to Be a Hero

episodes.synopsis: Amid speculation about how to improve their IS, Cecilia goes to each of her friends in search of the perfect bento lunch for Ichika.
episodes.title: Cooking My Way

episodes.synopsis: The IS class goes on a leisurely field trip with the girls vying for Ichika's attention. While leaving, the class is attacked at their various locations by Phantom Task.
episodes.title: Looking For Memories

episodes.synopsis: While Ichika battles Madoka's Black Knight IS, Tatenashi engages Squall atop a skyscraper. Meanwghile, Chifuyu and her students become trapped in a monorail containing a time bomb.
episodes.title: Girls Over
